rows.status: Substituted by HB12007

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE NATIONAL ENVIRONMENTAL MANAGEMENT AUTHORITY, DEFINING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Tasks the proposed Authority to formulate and implement an integrated approach towards the protection of the country's environment and resources, such as setting environmental QUALITY STANDARDS for water, air, land, noise, radiation, etc.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT ENTERPRISES AND PRIVATIZATION since 1998-07-30

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR SAFE DRINKING WATER, REGULATING FOR THAT PURPOSE PUBLIC WATER SYSTEMS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Safe Drinking Water Act of 1998". Substantiates the national policy on the establishment and maintenance of a COMPREHENSIVE NATIONAL REGULATION SYSTEM which considers the (1) quality of source waters; (2) protection afforded by watershed management; (3) treatment practices and other factors ensuring the safeness of drinking water.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 1998-07-30

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE GRAINS PRICE STABILIZATION FUND OF THE NATIONAL FOOD AUTHORITY (NFA) FOR ITS FOOD SECURITY AND STABILIZATION PROGRAM, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The Fund shall be used by the National Food Authority for its rice and corn procurement operations, and will be sourced  from taxes and tariffs on the importation of raw agricultural commodities.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE AND FOOD since 1998-07-30

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE NATIONAL LIVELIHOOD DEVELOPMENT COUNCIL THEREBY INSTITUTIONALIZ ING THE LIVELIHOOD MOVEMENT IN THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: "National Livelihood Development Act of 1998". With the proposed Council, the policies, standards and guidelines governing the implementation of livelihood programs and projects shall be formulated, monitored, reviewed, etc.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ECONOMIC AFFAIRS since 1998-07-30

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING CAPITAL MARKET DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION, DEFINING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Securities Market Development Act of 1998". Provides Stock Exchange -listed corporations and investors with incentives, such as (1) tax-deductible dividend payments or investments; (2) exemption from documentary stamp tax; (3) loss carryover, etc.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BANKS AND FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES since 1998-07-30

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING INCENTIVES TO DEVELOP THE PHILIPPINE SECURITIES MARKET("CAPITAL MARKET DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION ACT OF 1998")
rows.abstract: "Capital Market Development Commission Act of 1998". The proposed Commission shall formulate policies for the planning and implementation of a comprehensive program for the development of an effective securities market with the prices of securitiesset in a fair and orderly manner.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BANKS AND FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES since 1998-07-30

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING DOMESTIC COMMERCIAL AIRLINES AND SHIPPING FIRMS TO INSURE THEIR PASSENGERS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Provides the following amounts of insurance coverage for domestic airline and shipping firms passengers: (1) P300,000.00-dea th; (2) P150,000.00-ser ious injuries; (3) P100,000.00-les s serious injuries; and (4) P50,000.00 -slight injuries .
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION AND COMMUNICATIONS since 1998-07-30

rows.manual_status: Approved by the House and transmitted to the Senate on 1999-08-18
rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING THE FIRST DAY OF SHAWAL, THE TENTH MONTH OF THE MOSLEM CALENDAR A NATIONAL HOLIDAY FOR THE OBSERVANCE OF EIDUL FITR, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 26, CHAPTER 7 OF EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 292, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE ADMINISTRATIVE CODE OF 1987, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "EIDUL-FITR" is the first day marking the end of the 30-day fasting period of Ramadhan. The approximate date of the proposed national holiday will be movable.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 1999-08-17, transmitted to on 1999-08-18 and received by the Senate on 1999

second_reading.remarks: Considered the Explanatory Note as the sponsorship speech.

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTIONS 308, 329, 423, 433, 434, 436, AND 437 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991, TO STRENGTHEN AND PROVIDE GREATER AUTONOMY TO THE SANGGUNIANG KABATAAN, ITS CREATION, FUNCTIONS AND DUTIES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Sangguniang Kabataan Reforms Act of 1997".  Seeks to provide greater AUTONOMY and independence to the youth in the conduct and advancement of their affairs, free from political pressure and influence.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 1998-07-30

rows.abstract: Covers all CBEs with more than P500,000.00 capitalization, and engaged principally in manufacturing, processing and/or production-orie nted activities.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08336

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE CONDITIONS AND PROCEDURE FOR PROVIDING SUBSIDIES TO GOVERNMENT-OWNE D OR -CONTROLLED CORPORATIONS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Provides specific REQUIREMENTS to government corporations in order to qualify for government subsidies. Sets up the procedure for the grant of these subsidies.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT ENTERPRISES AND PRIVATIZATION since 1998-07-30

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A PERIODIC REVIEW OF THE ECONOMY, EFFICIENCY AND VIABILITY OF GOVERNMENT-OWNE D OR -CONTROLLED CORPORATIONS BY CONGRESS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Sunset Act of 1998". Substantiates the State policy to engage in business only in areas where there is a lack of private sector participation, or when the public good so requires.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT ENTERPRISES AND PRIVATIZATION since 1998-07-30

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING AND VESTING THE BUREAU OF FOOD AND DRUGS WITH QUASI-JUDICIAL POWERS, AMENDING CERTAIN SECTIONS OF REPUBLIC ACT NUMBERED THIRTY-SEVEN HUNDRED AND TWENTY, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'FOODS, DRUGS AND DEVICES, AND COSMETICSACT', AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Vests the Bureau of Food and Drugs with quasi-judicial powers to strengthen its monitoring and implementation functions. Clarifies the extent of the Bureau's power in the food and drugs industry.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 1998-07-30

rows.manual_status: Approved by the House and transmitted to the Senate on 2000-09-21
rows.author: C006
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2000-09-20 and transmitted to the Senate on 2000-09-21
rows.title_full: AN ACT RATIONALIZING FURTHER THE IMPOSITION OF PENAL SANCTIONS UNDER THE DANGEROUS DRUGS LAW OF 1972 BY PROVIDING PENALTIES SEPARATE AND DISTINCT FROM THOSE PROVIDED IN THE REVISED PENAL CODE (ACT NO. 3315, AS AMENDED) THEREBY PRECLUDING THE APPLICABILITY OF THE PROVISIONS OF THE LATTER IN DRUG OFFENSES, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE, REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6425, AS AMENDED BY REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7659
rows.abstract: Seeks to RESTORE the range of penalties provided under the Dangerous Drugs Act of 1972 and REIMPOSE the death penalty as a mandatory or discretionary sentence WITHOUT being encumbered by the technical nomenclature in the Revised Penal Code.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10665

rows.manual_status: Approved by the House and transmitted to the Senate on 2000-09-21
rows.author: C006
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2000-09-20 and transmitted to the Senate on 2000-09-21
rows.title_full: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE MANDATORY AND PERIODIC DRUG TESTING UNDER THE SUPERVISION OF THE DANGEROUS DRUGS BOARD AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: The provisions of this Act are MANDATORY for (1) high school and college students; (2) applicants for marriage license; (3) applicants for driver's license, permit to carry to carry firearms, employment; (4) public elective officials; and (5) military servicemen/wome n.
rows.status: Substituted by HB10665

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING THE TEACHING OF DISASTER AWARENESS, PREPAREDNESS AND HAZARD MITIGATION AS PART OF THE CURRICULUM OF ALL PRIMARY AND SECONDARY SCHOOLS IN THE COUNTRY AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Through this proposal, we can encourage the active participation of children, youth, students and school officials and personnel to promote disaster preparedness, awareness and lessen the hazards brought about by disasters.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 1998-07-30

rows.manual_status: Adopted as Resolution No. HR00100 on 2000-03-07
rows.author: C006
rows.mother_status: Adopted as Resolution No. HR00100 on 2000-03-07
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING GOVERNMENT ASSISTANCE IN THE FORM OF SCHOLARSHIP GRANTS TO THE YOUTH ENGAGED IN AGRICULTURE TO MAXIMIZE PRODUCTIVITY, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Declares it the policy of the State to provide assistance to the youth engaged in agriculture by providing them skills in agricultural management and technology transfer appropriate to the Philippines, to the end that productivity is maximized.
rows.status: Substituted by HR01313

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE MAXIMUM ALLOWABLE HAZARDS PAY OF GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS AND EMPLOYEES PERFORMING THEIR FUNCTIONS IN AREAS DECLARED AS CALAMITY AREAS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Grants said officials and employees a maximum allowable hazard pay of P1,000.00 a month.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 1998-07-30

rows.author: C006
rows.mother_status: Approved on Third Reading on 2001-05-30

rows.abstract: Requires that three (3) months from receipt of retirement application papers, the agency concerned shall act thereon, and FINAL COMPUTATION of the benefits shall be done SIXTY (60) DAYS before the employee's retirement date. Penalizes violation of this Act.
rows.status: Substituted by HB12835

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS AND EMPLOYEES FROM PLAYING IN CASINOS AND OTHER SIMILAR ESTABLISHMENTS OPERATED BY THE PHILIPPINE AMUSEMENT AND GAMING CORPORATION, OR BY OTHER SIMILAR GOVERNMENT-OWNE D OR -CONTROLLED CORPORATIONS, AND THEIRFRANCHISE HOLDERS, AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATION THEREOF
rows.abstract: Penalizes the government official or employee found guilty of violating this Act with imprisonment of six (6) months to six (6) years, and a fine of P10,000.00 to P30,000.00, in addition to PERPETUAL DISQUALIFICATIO N for holding public office.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 1998-07-30

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE CAPITALIZATION OF THE LIGHT RAIL TRANSIT AUTHORITY (LRTA) FROM THREE (3) BILLION PESOS TO TWELVE (12) BILLION PESOS BY FURTHER AMENDING ARTICLE 6, SECTION 15 OF EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 603, SERIES OF 1980, AS AMENDED
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION AND COMMUNICATIONS since 1998-07-30

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO LIMIT TO FILIPINO NATIONALS THE MANAGEMENT AND OPERATION OF LABOR RECRUITMENT COMPANIES FOR FOREIGN EMPLOYMENT
rows.abstract: Declares that NO foreign national shall act as officer in any capacity in any recruitment company, except as CONSULTANT for overseas land or seabased workers. States the criminal liabilities under this Act.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-30

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE FULL IMPLEMENTATION OF THE CONSTITUTIONAL PROVISION ON FREE ELEMENTARY AND SECONDARY EDUCATION AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Mandates the establishment of an elementary school in every barangay, and a secondary school in every municipality in the country, under the supervision of the DECS.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 1998-07-30

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING STUDENTS IN THE PRIMARY SCHOOL LEVEL A DISCOUNT IN FARES EQUIVALENT TO FIFTY PERCENT OF THE REGULAR FARES PAID BY USERS OF PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION OPERATED, OWNED OR -CONTROLLED BY THE GOVERNMENT AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Penalizes the officer or employee of any public transportation operated, owned or controlled by the government, found violating this Act with a fine equivalent to one (1) month salary of the offender, or with imprisonment of not less than fifteen (15) days.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION AND COMMUNICATIONS since 1998-07-30

rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING ARTICLE 177 OF EXECUTIVE ORDER 209, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE FAMILY CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES (RE: LEGITIMATION OF CHILDREN BORN TO UNDERAGE COUPLES)
rows.abstract: Refers to the LEGITIMATION of children born to UNDERAGE couples. States that those conceived and born to parents under the age of majority (below 18 years of age) may be eligible for legitimation by the SUBSEQUENT MARRIAGE of the parents to each other.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08918

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN EMPLOYEES' COMPENSATION ADMINISTRATION TO SUPPLANT THE PROVISIONS OF TITLE II, BOOK IV OF THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES (P.D. 442, AS AMENDED)
rows.abstract: The proposed EMPLOYEES' COMPENSATION ADMINISTRATION is expected to (1) achieve uniformity in implementing policy, procedures, thereby eliminating disparities in the grant of benefits; (2) extend timely and responsive delivery of benefits to workers;and (3) attain operational efficiency.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LABOR AND EMPLOYMENT since 1998-07-30

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT REQUIRING FOR THE INCLUSION OF THE SUBJECT ON COOPERATIVES AS A SUBJECT IN THE CURRICULA OF ELEMENTARY AND SECONDARY SCHOOLS
rows.abstract: "National Cooperatives Education Act of 1995". Aims to instill in the youth the principles of self-help, democratic control and equitable distribution of wealth.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 1998-07-30

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT LOWERING THE COSTS OF MEDICINES AND HEALTH CARE IN THE PHILIPPINES BY EXEMPTING THE SALE, IMPORTATION, PROCESSING, REPACKING OR MANUFACTURING OF MEDICINES, PHARMACEUTICAL PRODUCTS; MEDICAL, DENTAL AND HOSPITAL EQUIPMENT; AND RAW MATERIALS TOBE USED IN THE MANUFACTURE THEREOF, FROM ALL DUTIES AND TAXES
rows.abstract: Seeks to LOWER the cost of health care and make medicines more affordable.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 1998-07-30

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE SALE, DISTRIBUTION AND ADMINISTRATION OF MISLABELED, ADULTERATED AND EXPIRED MEDICINES, AND PROVIDING PENALTIES THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Directs the Secretary of Health to furnish and publish a LIST OF BANNED MEDICINES. Penalizes violation of this Act with two (2) to four (4) years imprisonment, or a fine of P30,000.00 to P50,000.00.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 1998-07-30

rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE CAPABILITY OF THE BUREAU OF FOOD AND DRUGS BY UPGRADING ITS EQUIPMENT AND ESTABLISHING ADEQUATE TESTING LABORATORIES IN VISAYAS AND MINDANAO, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: Mandates the DOH to improve and increase the capability of the Bureau of Food and Drugs by establishing at least one (1) test laboratory each in Luzon, Visayas and Mindanao, complete with up-to-date facilities.
rows.status: Substituted by HB02089

rows.abstract: Proposes this measure to help solve the traffic situation in highly urbanized cities.
rows.status: Substituted by HB12835

rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE AND FOOD since 1998-07-30

rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 1998-07-30

rows.title_full: AN ACT LIFTING THE BAN ON ELECTION PROPAGANDA FOR PARTIES AND CANDIDATES SEEKING NATIONAL ELECTIVE OFFICES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE BATAS PAMBANSA BLG. 881, SECTIONS 85 AND 86; AND REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6646, SECTIONS 10 AND 11

rows.status: Substituted by HB09000

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING PROFIT-SHARING IN ALL BUSINESS ENTERPRISES, INCLUDING GOVERNMENT-OWNE D AND -CONTROLLED CORPORATIONS
rows.abstract: Mandates every enterprise of any kind to establish a PROFIT-SHARING SYSTEM as an integral part of its regular over-all administrative organization under certain guidelines.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ELIMINATION OF RED TAPE AND NEEDLESS PAPERWORK IN GOVERNMENT, PRESCRIBING PENALTIES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Anti-Red Tape Act of 1998". Directs all government agencies and offices to re-engineer their operating systems and procedures to ensure fast, efficient and honest services to the people. Prescribes guidelines towards this end.
rows.status: Substituted by HB07230

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE PHILIPPINE COMMISSION ON WOMEN, DEFINING ITS POWERS, FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIE S, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Designates the proposed Commission to implement the laws on women, review and evaluate the extent of women's integration in all sectors of society. ABOLISHES, therefore, the National Commission on the Role of Filipino Women.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WOMEN since 1998-07-30

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROTECTING THE INCUMBENT AND FORMER OFFICERS AND EMPLOYEES IN THE CIVIL SERVICE AS WELL AS APPLICANTS FOR GOVERNMENT EMPLOYMENT FROM REPRISAL OR HARASSMENT FOR MAKING DISCLOSURES IN THE PUBLIC INTEREST AND PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS THEREOF
rows.abstract: "Watchdog Act of 1998".  Is intended to protect innocent government employees from career reprisals.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR WOMEN EMPOWERMENT AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Women Empowerment Act of 1998". Raises the status of women by mandating the allocation of certain government positions to owmen, thereby giving them opportunitie to excel in their respective fields and contribute to national development.
rows.status: Business for the day on 2000-03-06

rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROTECT THE FOREST BY BANNING ALL COMMERCIAL LOGGING OPERATIONS, PROVIDING MECHANISMS FOR ITS EFFECTIVE ENFORCEMENT AND IMPLEMENTATION AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Total commercial Logging Ban Act of 1998". The author explains that "the policy reform for a total log ban has been too much delayed and compromised to the detriment of the next generation. The time to act is now." Declares it UNLAWFUL for any person to cut, fell, or destroy any tree or engage in commercial logging operations for a period of at least THIRTY (30) YEARS from the effectivity of this Act.
rows.status: Substituted by HB12710

rows.abstract: Vests the power to REMOVE local officials solely on the PEOPLE who elected the same. Abolishes, therefore, the Preparatory Recall Assembly.

rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 1998-07-30

rows.author: A040
